init.description:
### Friendly AES67 stream names
Give discovered streams readable labels in Home Assistant only. In **AES67 source IP to friendly name**, enter an encoder-IP-to-name mapping, for example:
```yaml
"192.0.2.10": "Apple TV"
"192.0.2.11": "Cable"
```
Replace these example IPs with your encoders' IPs, not the NAX IP or multicast addresses. The AES67 Stream dropdown will show `Apple TV [192.0.2.10]`; the zone's Source dropdown still says AES67. Hardware names and routing are unchanged. An empty mapping uses advertised names. Update automations that use exact option labels after renaming.

### Optional Media Player 2
Only for the NAX's built-in music players; leave disabled for NVX/AES67. Before enabling, follow the [step-by-step setup guide](https://github.com/Phant0mElit3/ha-dm-nax/blob/main/docs/MEDIA_AND_AUTOMATION.md#optional-media-player-2). The device must already use MP2 and this integration must use HTTPS. Switching to MP2 reboots the NAX. Enter the UUID and Secret from a dedicated device-console `createclient` command, not your web login. Leave the secret blank on later edits to retain it. Enabling this option does not switch modes, create credentials, or configure music accounts.
